runs.box: OUT AT Q2; integrity facts recorded, not judged
runs.entry: Price **$0.0001** (OTC WLGSF close 2026-10-16, Yahoo chart feed through `tools/sources.py`, aggregator, flagged; it trades, 98,200 shares that day; $0.004 to $0.013 September 2025 to July 2026, $0.0001 since 2026-07-28). Shares **17,357,924** at 2024-12-31 (FY2024 20-F cover, Note 11, no treasury shares); 174,679,566 before and about 698,719 after the 250-to-1 combination of 2025-09-02 (6-K 0001641172-25-025052); **the count after that date is not on file** (the $8M convertible notes of June 2025 and the reset warrants of March 2025 could each have added shares); market value not computable; `cover_shares.py` and `tools/run.py` found nothing (the delisted ticker has left the SEC ticker file; run.py through a CIK wrapper: UNRESEARCHED). Sovereign: **not obtained from the issuing authority**; the HKMA API returned HTTP 405 to every request, so the US Treasury 30-year par yield **5.43%** (2026-10-16) stands in as a CONVENTION of the run on the peg the 20-F states; it cannot change the sign of any figure (the KAZR and SUGP cycles of the same day took 4.519% from the HKSAR 20-year benchmark; no HKD row in the protocol's table). Read from the 20-F for FY2024 (0001641172-25-010670, filed 2025-05-15), the 20-Fs for FY2023 and FY2022 and its 20-F/A, the F-1/A of 2023-03-28 (FY2020 and FY2021), every 6-K October 2024 to August 2025, the two 424B5s of 2025, the NT 20-F and the Form 25-NSE of 2025-11-21 (0001354457-25-001166); **the company has filed nothing since**, no 20-F for FY2025, no 2025 interim, its website silent since April 2023; the latest audited year is FY2024; cross-check: FY2024 contract revenue $3,951,649 in the audited statement equals the XBRL fact. Lines of evidence derived by the analyst from the 20-F's Items 3.D, 4 and 5. The 20-F names no rival; Masonglory, Ming Shing and SU Group, the Hong Kong trade contractors an EDGAR full-text search returned, read from their own 20-F XBRL facts as a CONVENTION of the run. **Q1 IN** **[M2012-065]**, **[M1998-044]**, **[M2008-033]**, **[M2011-014]**: a Hong Kong E&M contractor (low-voltage electrical, ventilation and air-conditioning, fire services, plumbing, fitting-out) bidding for work, 138 tenders in 2024 at about 36%, fixed unit price contracts, about 69% of prime work subcontracted, five customers 88% to 98% of revenue with no long-term contract; the solar, energized-panel and Queensland ventures 3% of FY2024 revenue, so the contracting business decides; the doubt from the stopped reporting written down and named as a framework gap (another analyst could close at Q1 TOO HARD). **Q2 OUT** **[M2017-009]**, **[L2004-003]**, **[M1997-010]**, **[M2001-013]**, **[M2012-106]**, **[M2013-052]**, **[M1999-108]**: no castle shown on the evidence; work won on the bid (its own risk factor "We may lose business to competitors that underbid us"), no low-cost position claimed, gross margin 18.0%, 20.8%, 18.8%, 35.8%, 10.4% 2020 to 2024 with the 2024 trough from one project's labour overrun, operating result $142,626 in 2020 to $(2,548,875) in 2024, the 20-F's own "declining demand in traditional construction"; operating result on revenue over the span -18.0% (-8.9% before listing fees) against Masonglory -6.0%, Ming Shing -2.5%, SU Group +2.1%, all four in loss in the latest year. After the stop, facts recorded, not judged: shares 17.36M to 174.68M in 2025 through reset warrants and $8M of convertible notes at 85% of the lowest VWAP for net proceeds of about $3.57M; Nasdaq's delisting partly on "public interest concerns" about those notes; a "US$71 Million Contract" for marble quarrying and a solar crypto farm announced while the core business lost money; 1,400,000 shares placed at $0.25 a month before the $5.00 IPO; the audited subsequent-events note dated "May [ ], 2025" with the blank unfilled; material weaknesses; Solar (HK) Limited bought for HK$15,000,000, about 45% of year-end cash, first by a note convertible at 80% of market, then in cash; equity $(0.77)M to $(1.71)M before the IPO, $6.01M after it, $3.49M after the 2024 loss; receivables and contract assets from about 51% to 100% of revenue, $1.52M of trade receivables non-current, credit-loss charge $6k to $636k; bank loans $2.34M and director's advances $1.37M. COMPUTATION, NOT A CLEARANCE: owner cash (operating cash flow less capital spending) negative every year FY2020 to FY2024, average $(1,259,439), $(1,202,426) before interest; the no-growth case alone; net debt $1,370,724 (director's advances and the Solar HK price counted); **value range $(23.5)M for the equity, $(1.35) a share** on the last audited count ($(33.65) on the post-combination count), the price above the top; **no positive fair price**: $(0.77) a share all-equity, $(0.73) equity-only, not armed (box not OUT at Q7 or IN). Contamination declared by the analyst: one `Test Runs` listing showing the file names of other runs dated 2026-10-17, among them SUGP, and CKSNY commit subjects in the session context; none opened; SU Group used only from its own SEC filings, chosen by the stated search. Commits f1c1a8c1 (template), 21e604e6 (Step 0, foundations, standing rule), 09b764e4 (Q1), 655c9eb3 (Q2), 3fef48cc (the rest). Position note filled at the fold: not held. Citations: the analyst's `check_ids.py` 0 problems across 33 ids; the dispatcher's `dispatcher_adjacent.py` checked 16 fragments beside an id, 0 problems; no E-ids; **no citation slip**. No tracked research file over 200 KB. check_framework PASS. **For the operator** (the analyst's framework notes): a filer that has stopped filing (Q1 IN on the last audited years against Q1 TOO HARD on the doubt row, and which cause); no HKD sovereign row and an HKMA API that refuses automated requests; comparables when the filer names none; per-share figures with an unknown share count; Q7 with negative owner cash in every year (whether a negative range means no fair price). Could not get: the HKD sovereign from the HKMA, the share count after September 2025 and the fate of the $8M notes, any interim after H1 2024, a proxy (none for this filer; the 2024 AGM 6-Ks read instead).
runs.narr: OUT at Q2 (WANG & LEE GROUP, Inc., OTC WLGSF, formerly Nasdaq WLGS, delisted 2025-12-01 and silent on EDGAR since the Form 25 of 2025-11-21, latest audited year FY2024; a Hong Kong electrical and mechanical tender contractor with no castle shown on the evidence: work won on the bid at fixed unit prices, five customers 88% to 98% of revenue, no low-cost position, gross margin 18.0% to 35.8% to 10.4%, operating loss of 64.5% of revenue in 2024, the filer worst of four Hong Kong trade contractors over the span. Facts recorded, not judged: shares up tenfold in 2025 through reset warrants and $8M of discounted convertible notes, Nasdaq's public-interest delisting, a crypto-farm and marble-quarry contract announced while the core lost money, a pre-IPO placing at $0.25 against the $5.00 IPO, a blank date in the audited subsequent-events note. Computation beneath the stop: owner cash negative all five years, value range $(1.35) a share on the last audited count, no positive fair price, against $0.0001, not armed. No citation slip. Framework gaps for the operator: a filer that has stopped filing, no HKD sovereign row (US 30-year stand-in, HKMA API refused), comparables when the filer names none, an unknown share count, a negative value in Q7.)
